description: This file implements the Time class and related functions for handling date and time operations, including parsing various date formats, conversions between local and UTC time, and generating string representations in different formats. It also includes platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: A class representing date and time, providing methods for parsing, formatting, and conversions between time zones and formats.

methods.name: IsValidDate
methods.description: Checks if a given date (year, month, day) is valid.

methods.name: ToLocal
methods.description: Converts the stored time to local time.

methods.name: ToUTC
methods.description: Converts the stored time to UTC.

methods.name: Ticks
methods.description: Returns the time in microseconds since epoch.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats the time into a string based on a formatter.

methods.name: ToRFC1123
methods.description: Returns the time formatted as RFC 1123 string.

methods.name: ToISO8601
methods.description: Returns the time formatted as ISO 8601 string.

methods.name: ToTimeOnly
methods.description: Returns the time portion as a string.

methods.name: DayOfWeek
methods.description: Returns the day of the week.

methods.name: DayOfYear
methods.description: Returns the day of the year.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds milliseconds to the current time.

methods.name: Sub
methods.description: Subtracts milliseconds from the current time.

methods.name: NTPTime
methods.description: Returns the NTP timestamp representation of the time.
